draft_en.subject: Your bypass-switch enquiry on Alibaba - industrial managed unit with hardware bypass
draft_en.body:
Hi Igor,

You asked on Alibaba about bypass modules and did not get a proper answer from us - apologies, here it is.

We do not sell the bypass module on its own; we supply it built into an industrial switch: DIN-rail L2+ managed, 8 x Gigabit RJ45 (PoE+ version) + 4 x SFP, hardware optical bypass on the fibre uplinks, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS (EAC stays on your side) - $186.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the non-PoE version - $172.2. Alongside it, the regular DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP L2 managed unit, STI-280GM, $68.2.

One question: is the bypass needed on the copper ports or on the fibre uplinks in your design?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
